lines.watchItem: Merchant-GPU demand runs very strong with record data-center revenue, and the next wave of accelerators from NVIDIA, AMD, Amazon, and Google all reach mass production in the second half of 2026. Leading-edge wafer-start planning is exposed to that broad, simultaneous ramp; watch whether all four programs hold their volumes.

Advanced packaging is sold out through 2027 with lead times of 52 to 78 weeks, and suppliers describe the shortfall as large into 2029-2030. Realizable GPU revenue is capped by this packaging line; watch the monthly wafer ramp toward 125-130k and how fast the order gap narrows.

Custom hyperscaler chips are growing far faster than merchant GPUs and are taking share as NVIDIA's slips from 87 percent toward 75 percent. The leading-node customer base is exposed to a shift from a few GPU vendors toward in-house designs; watch how much of that custom volume lands on the leading node.

TSMC gross margin rose to 67.7 percent while packaging stays fully booked and end-market demand is firm. How much pricing power holds across the chain tracks how long this sold-out condition lasts; watch margin and lead times for any loosening.

The top three packaging clients take more than 85 percent of output, with one buyer near 60 percent, and that same buyer's largest three customers make up over half its revenue. The packaging book is exposed to a narrow set of buyers; watch whether any single program slips.

Memory supply is now capping shipments, with HBM sold out through 2026, contract prices set to roughly double, and Micron's output gating GPU availability. Even ample packaging is exposed to this second choke point; watch HBM supply as a limit on realizable GPU output.

Intel's foundry revenue grew 31 percent and its data-center chip line grew 59 percent, marking a returning second source. Foundry demand is exposed to buyers gaining an alternative supplier; watch Intel's foundry traction for any pull on leading-node orders.

NVIDIA's China revenue fell by more than half as only about ten buyers cleared case-by-case export review. Foundry demand tied to China-bound parts is exposed to policy swings; watch approval volumes as a swing factor on that slice of orders.
